steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. An item counts as done only if it was demonstrated and has an outcome.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 item marked done was not demonstrated

findings.title: Item marked done but not demonstrated
findings.fix: Demonstrate it or mark it not done

findings.title: Changed scope with no reason
findings.fix: Record the reason for the change

outcome.notChecked: Whether the outcome meets the user's need.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] demo-search:12  Item marked done but not demonstrated.
       Fix: Demonstrate it or mark it not done.
[medium] demo-theme:19  Completed item with no outcome.
       Fix: Record the outcome.
[low] demo-audit:26  Changed scope with no reason.
       Fix: Record the reason for the change.
Not checked: Whether the outcome meets the user's need.
pros: Checks a completed item with no outcome, an item marked done that was not demonstrated, and a changed scope with no reason.
cons: Not checked: Whether the outcome meets the user's need.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-sprint-review-pack skill on the records for this review.
